leadText:
Marius (Japanese: ヨウスケ Yōsuke) is a character of the day who appeared in The Spheal of Approval. He is the self-appointed security guard of 's Oceanic Museum.

Marius spotted Max as he was trying to climb the wall of the closed museum. As a result, he assumed that and Max were trying to break in because they were thieves. At this, Marius sent out his to attack them, not listening to their repeated denials. However, Spheal wasn't interested in battling and only wanted to play. quickly defeated Spheal with a single , leaving Marius speechless. Max explained s are weak against moves.

Soon, Captain Stern arrived, and Marius promptly told him Ash and Max were thieves. Max explained that he just wanted to see the museum. After dealing with the misunderstanding, Captain Stern invited them all in to see the museum. Marius displayed his lack of knowledge about Pokémon during the tour, where he declared that he wanted to catch a so it could evolve into a . Max corrected him, saying only evolve into Gyarados. Marius also dreamed about traveling around the world by sea inside the submarine that the Captain was building.

Marius, Ash, and Max were later captured by after being lured out by snow cones. They soon escaped with the help of Ash's Corphish and confronted Team Magma, who had stolen Stern's valuable rock. Captain Stern and Ash handled Team Magma while Marius and Max were ordered to get Officer Jenny. Marius and Max jumped off a steep sea cliff, while his Spheal aided the pair in reaching the police. By the time the police arrived, Team Magma fled with a portion of the stone. Afterwards, Marius informed Ash of his desire to have a rematch the next time they met.
